helpers.statement:
∀ f : KdVPlan.Coeff, KdVPlan.MemH 0 f → KdVPlan.HB 1 (KdVPlan.invD f) (2 * KdVPlan.hn 0 f) ∧ Summable (fun k => ‖KdVPlan.invD f k‖) ∧
 (∑' k, ‖KdVPlan.invD f k‖) ≤ KdVPlan.hn 0 (fun k => (Complex.I * (k : ℂ))⁻¹) * KdVPlan.hn 0 f
helpers.proof:
intro f hf
have hnrm := (yui_aux_0008 T gamma R h_T013).1
constructor
· apply yui_aux_0002 T gamma R h_T013 1 0 (KdVPlan.invD f) f 2 (by norm_num) hf
  intro k
  by_cases hk : k = 0
  · simp [hk, KdVPlan.invD, KdVPlan.weight]
  have hkR : (k : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hk
  have hk1 : 1 ≤ |(k : ℝ)| := by exact_mod_cast Int.one_le_abs hk
  have hk2 : 1 ≤ (k : ℝ)^2 := by nlinarith [sq_abs (k : ℝ)]
  have H : (1+(k : ℝ)^2) / (k : ℝ)^2 ≤ 2^2 := (div_le_iff₀ (sq_pos_of_ne_zero hkR)).mpr (by nlinarith)
  calc
   KdVPlan.weight 1 k * ‖KdVPlan.invD f k‖^2 = ((1+(k : ℝ)^2) / (k : ℝ)^2) * ‖f k‖^2 := by
    rw [(hnrm f k).2.1]
    simp only [KdVPlan.weight, Real.rpow_one, mul_pow, inv_pow, sq_abs]
    ring
   _ ≤ 2^2 * (KdVPlan.weight 0 k * ‖f k‖^2) := by simpa [KdVPlan.weight] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right H (sq_nonneg ‖f k‖)
· have H := (yui_aux_0005 T gamma R h_T013 _ f (yui_aux_0008 T gamma R h_T013).2 hf).1
  have he : (fun k => ‖KdVPlan.invD f k‖) = (fun k : ℤ => ‖(Complex.I * (k : ℂ))⁻¹‖ * ‖f k‖) := by
    funext k; rw [(hnrm f k).1, norm_mul]
  simpa only [he] using H

helpers.name: yui_aux_0011
helpers.statement:
(∀ f : KdVPlan.Coeff, KdVPlan.MemH 1 f → KdVPlan.HB 0 f (KdVPlan.hn 1 f) ∧ KdVPlan.HB 0 (KdVPlan.dx f) (KdVPlan.hn 1 f)) ∧
 (∀ f : KdVPlan.Coeff, KdVPlan.MemH 0 f → KdVPlan.MemH 0 (KdVPlan.dx f) → KdVPlan.HB 1 f (KdVPlan.hn 0 f+KdVPlan.hn 0 (KdVPlan.dx f)))
helpers.proof:
constructor
· intro f hf
  refine ⟨h_T013.2.2.2.1 0 1 f (by norm_num) hf, ?_⟩
  have H := yui_aux_0002 T gamma R h_T013 0 1 (KdVPlan.dx f) f 1 (by norm_num) hf (fun k => ?_)
  · simpa using H
  · rw [(yui_aux_0008 T gamma R h_T013).1 f k |>.2.2]
    simp only [KdVPlan.weight, Real.rpow_zero, Real.rpow_one, one_mul, one_pow, mul_pow, sq_abs]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg ‖f k‖]
· intro f hf hdf
  have he : (fun k => KdVPlan.weight 1 k * ‖f k‖^2) = (fun k => KdVPlan.weight 0 k * ‖f k‖^2 + KdVPlan.weight 0 k * ‖KdVPlan.dx f k‖^2) := by
   funext k
   rw [(yui_aux_0008 T gamma R h_T013).1 f k |>.2.2]
   simp only [KdVPlan.weight, Real.rpow_zero, Real.rpow_one, one_mul, mul_pow, sq_abs]
   ring
  have hsum : KdVPlan.MemH 1 f := by rw [KdVPlan.MemH, he]; exact hf.add hdf
  refine ⟨hsum, ?_⟩
  have h0 : 0 ≤ ∑' k, KdVPlan.weight 0 k * ‖f k‖^2 := tsum_nonneg (fun k => by simp [KdVPlan.weight])
  have hd0 : 0 ≤ ∑' k, KdVPlan.weight 0 k * ‖KdVPlan.dx f k‖^2 := tsum_nonneg (fun k => by simp [KdVPlan.weight])
  dsimp [KdVPlan.hn]
  rw [he, hf.tsum_add hdf]
  apply Real.sqrt_le_iff.mpr
  refine ⟨by positivity, ?_⟩
  nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt h0, Real.sq_sqrt hd0, Real.sqrt_nonneg (∑' k, KdVPlan.weight 0 k * ‖f k‖^2), Real.sqrt_nonneg (∑' k, KdVPlan.weight 0 k * ‖KdVPlan.dx f k‖^2)]

helpers.statement: ∀ f : KdVPlan.Coeff, KdVPlan.MemH 1 f → Summable (fun k => ‖f k‖) ∧ (∑' k, ‖f k‖) ≤ (1 + KdVPlan.hn 0 (fun k => (Complex.I * (k : ℂ))⁻¹)) * KdVPlan.hn 1 f
helpers.proof:
intro f hf
let D := KdVPlan.hn 0 (fun k => (Complex.I * (k : ℂ))⁻¹)
have HD : 0 ≤ D := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
have H := (yui_aux_0011 T gamma R h_T013).1 f hf
have HI := yui_aux_0009 T gamma R h_T013 (KdVPlan.dx f) H.2.1
have hs := yui_aux_0012 T gamma R h_T013 ‖f 0‖
have he : (fun k => ‖f k‖) = (fun k => (if k = 0 then ‖f 0‖ else 0) + ‖KdVPlan.invD (KdVPlan.dx f) k‖) := by
 funext k
 rw [(yui_aux_0013 T gamma R h_T013 f).1]
 simp only [KdVPlan.P]
 split_ifs with hk <;> simp [hk]
have hpt : ‖f 0‖ ≤ KdVPlan.hn 1 f := by
 let x : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2 := ⟨f, (yui_aux_0003 T gamma R h_T013 f).1.mp H.1.1⟩
 have hnorm : KdVPlan.hn 0 f = ‖x‖ := (yui_aux_0003 T gamma R h_T013 f).2 _
 exact (lp.norm_apply_le_norm (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ 0) x 0).trans (hnorm ▸ H.1.2)
refine ⟨he ▸ hs.1.add HI.2.1, ?_⟩
calc
 (∑' k, ‖f k‖) = ‖f 0‖ + ∑' k, ‖KdVPlan.invD (KdVPlan.dx f) k‖ := by rw [he, hs.1.tsum_add HI.2.1, hs.2]
 _ ≤ KdVPlan.hn 1 f + D * KdVPlan.hn 1 f := add_le_add hpt (HI.2.2.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left H.2.2 HD))
 _ = (1 + D) * KdVPlan.hn 1 f := by ring

helpers.name: yui_aux_0015
helpers.statement:
(∀ f g : KdVPlan.Coeff, KdVPlan.mul f g = KdVPlan.mul g f) ∧
 (∀ f g : KdVPlan.Coeff, KdVPlan.MemH 1 f → KdVPlan.MemH 1 g → KdVPlan.dx (KdVPlan.mul f g) = KdVPlan.mul (KdVPlan.dx f) g + KdVPlan.mul f (KdVPlan.dx g))
helpers.proof:
constructor
· intro f g
  funext k
  change (∑' j : ℤ, f j * g (k-j)) = ∑' j : ℤ, g j * f (k-j)
  calc
   (∑' j : ℤ, f j * g (k-j)) = ∑' j : ℤ, f (k-j) * g (k-(k-j)) := ((Equiv.subLeft k).tsum_eq _).symm
   _ = ∑' j : ℤ, g j * f (k-j) := by apply tsum_congr; intro j; simp [mul_comm]
· intro f g hf hg
  have Hf := (yui_aux_0011 T gamma R h_T013).1 f hf
  have Hg := (yui_aux_0011 T gamma R h_T013).1 g hg
  funext k
  have h₁ := (yui_aux_0005 T gamma R h_T013 (KdVPlan.dx f) g Hf.2.1 Hg.1.1).2 k |>.1
  have h₂ := (yui_aux_0005 T gamma R h_T013 f (KdVPlan.dx g) Hf.1.1 Hg.2.1).2 k |>.1
  change Complex.I * (k : ℂ) * (∑' j : ℤ, f j * g (k-j)) =
    (∑' j : ℤ, KdVPlan.dx f j * g (k-j)) + ∑' j : ℤ, f j * KdVPlan.dx g (k-j)
  rw [← tsum_mul_left, ← h₁.tsum_add h₂]
  apply tsum_congr
  intro j
  simp only [KdVPlan.dx, Int.cast_sub]
  ring

∀ f g : KdVPlan.Coeff, KdVPlan.MemH 1 f → KdVPlan.MemH 1 g →
 KdVPlan.HB 1 (KdVPlan.mul f g) (3 * (1 + KdVPlan.hn 0 (fun k => (Complex.I * (k : ℂ))⁻¹)) * KdVPlan.hn 1 f * KdVPlan.hn 1 g)
helpers.proof:
intro f g hf hg
let E := 1 + KdVPlan.hn 0 (fun k => (Complex.I * (k : ℂ))⁻¹)
have hE : 0 ≤ E := by dsimp [E, KdVPlan.hn]; positivity
have lf := yui_aux_0014 T gamma R h_T013 f hf
have lg := yui_aux_0014 T gamma R h_T013 g hg
have Hf := (yui_aux_0011 T gamma R h_T013).1 f hf
have Hg := (yui_aux_0011 T gamma R h_T013).1 g hg
have H₀ := yui_aux_0007 T gamma R h_T013 f g lf.1 Hg.1.1
have H₁ := yui_aux_0007 T gamma R h_T013 g (KdVPlan.dx f) lg.1 Hf.2.1
have H₂ := yui_aux_0007 T gamma R h_T013 f (KdVPlan.dx g) lf.1 Hg.2.1
have b₀ : KdVPlan.hn 0 (KdVPlan.mul f g) ≤ E * KdVPlan.hn 1 f * KdVPlan.hn 1 g := by
 apply H₀.2.trans
 exact mul_le_mul lf.2 Hg.1.2 (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg hE (Real.sqrt_nonneg _))
have b₁ : KdVPlan.hn 0 (KdVPlan.mul g (KdVPlan.dx f)) ≤ E * KdVPlan.hn 1 f * KdVPlan.hn 1 g := by
 apply H₁.2.trans
 calc
  (∑' k, ‖g k‖) * KdVPlan.hn 0 (KdVPlan.dx f) ≤ (E * KdVPlan.hn 1 g) * KdVPlan.hn 1 f :=
   mul_le_mul lg.2 Hf.2.2 (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg hE (Real.sqrt_nonneg _))
  _ = E * KdVPlan.hn 1 f * KdVPlan.hn 1 g := by ring
have b₂ : KdVPlan.hn 0 (KdVPlan.mul f (KdVPlan.dx g)) ≤ E * KdVPlan.hn 1 f * KdVPlan.hn 1 g := by
 apply H₂.2.trans
 exact mul_le_mul lf.2 Hg.2.2 (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg hE (Real.sqrt_nonneg _))
have hd : KdVPlan.dx (KdVPlan.mul f g) = KdVPlan.mul g (KdVPlan.dx f) + KdVPlan.mul f (KdVPlan.dx g) := by
 rw [(yui_aux_0015 T gamma R h_T013).2 f g hf hg, (yui_aux_0015 T gamma R h_T013).1 (KdVPlan.dx f) g]

change KdVPlan.hn 0 (KdVPlan.mul f g) + KdVPlan.hn 0 (KdVPlan.dx (KdVPlan.mul f g)) ≤ 3 * E * KdVPlan.hn 1 f * KdVPlan.hn 1 g

helpers.statement:
(∀ s t : ℝ, ∀ f : KdVPlan.Coeff, KdVPlan.MemH s f → KdVPlan.MemH s (KdVPlan.S t f) ∧ KdVPlan.hn s (KdVPlan.S t f) = KdVPlan.hn s f ∧ KdVPlan.HB s (KdVPlan.P f) (KdVPlan.hn s f)) ∧
(∀ s N : ℝ, ∀ f : KdVPlan.Coeff, KdVPlan.MemH s f → KdVPlan.HB s (KdVPlan.cutoff N f) (KdVPlan.hn s f)) ∧
(∀ f g : KdVPlan.Coeff, ∀ t : ℝ, KdVPlan.S t (f-g) = KdVPlan.S t f-KdVPlan.S t g ∧ KdVPlan.invD (f-g) = KdVPlan.invD f-KdVPlan.invD g ∧ KdVPlan.P (f-g) = KdVPlan.P f-KdVPlan.P g ∧ KdVPlan.dx (f-g) = KdVPlan.dx f-KdVPlan.dx g)
helpers.proof:
constructor
· intro s t f hf
  have hnrm : ∀ k, ‖KdVPlan.S t f k‖ = ‖f k‖ := yui_aux_0017 T gamma R h_T013 t f
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [KdVPlan.MemH, hnrm] using hf
  · simp only [KdVPlan.hn, hnrm]
  · have H := yui_aux_0002 T gamma R h_T013 s s (KdVPlan.P f) f 1 (by norm_num) hf (fun k => ?_)
    · simpa only [one_mul] using H
    · by_cases hk : k = 0
      · simp [KdVPlan.P, hk, KdVPlan.weight]
      · simp [KdVPlan.P, hk]
constructor
· intro s N f hf
  have H := yui_aux_0002 T gamma R h_T013 s s (KdVPlan.cutoff N f) f 1 (by norm_num) hf (fun k => ?_)
  · simpa only [one_mul] using H
  · by_cases hk : |(k : ℝ)| ≤ N
    · simp [KdVPlan.cutoff, hk]
    · simp [KdVPlan.cutoff, hk]; exact mul_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg (by positivity) _) (sq_nonneg _)
· intro f g t
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · funext k; simp [KdVPlan.S, mul_sub]
  · funext k; by_cases hk : k = 0 <;> simp [KdVPlan.invD, hk, mul_sub]
  · funext k; by_cases hk : k = 0 <;> simp [KdVPlan.P, hk]
  · funext k; simp [KdVPlan.dx, mul_sub]

helpers.statement: Summable (fun k : ℤ => KdVPlan.weight (-KdVPlan.pstar) k * (k : ℝ)^2) ∧ ∀ k : ℤ, k ≠ 0 → KdVPlan.weight (-KdVPlan.pstar) k ≤ (k : ℝ)⁻¹^2
helpers.proof:
constructor
· apply Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun k => mul_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg (by positivity) _) (sq_nonneg _)) _ (Real.summable_abs_int_rpow (b := 9/7) (by norm_num))
  intro k
  by_cases hk : k = 0
  · simp [hk, KdVPlan.weight]
  have hkR : (k : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hk
  have habs : 0 < |(k : ℝ)| := abs_pos.mpr hkR
  have h : KdVPlan.weight (-KdVPlan.pstar) k ≤ ((k : ℝ)^2) ^ (-KdVPlan.pstar) :=
   Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos (sq_pos_of_ne_zero hkR) (by linarith) (by norm_num [KdVPlan.pstar])
  calc
   KdVPlan.weight (-KdVPlan.pstar) k * (k : ℝ)^2 ≤ ((k : ℝ)^2) ^ (-KdVPlan.pstar) * (k : ℝ)^2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h (sq_nonneg _)
   _ = |(k : ℝ)| ^ (-(9/7 : ℝ)) := by
    rw [← sq_abs (k : ℝ), ← Real.rpow_two |(k : ℝ)|, ← Real.rpow_mul (le_of_lt habs), ← Real.rpow_add habs]
    norm_num [KdVPlan.pstar]
· intro k hk
  have hkR : (k : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hk
  calc
   KdVPlan.weight (-KdVPlan.pstar) k ≤ (1+(k : ℝ)^2) ^ (-1 : ℝ) :=
    Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (k : ℝ)]) (by norm_num [KdVPlan.pstar])
   _ ≤ ((k : ℝ)^2) ^ (-1 : ℝ) := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos (sq_pos_of_ne_zero hkR) (by linarith) (by norm_num)
   _ = (k : ℝ)⁻¹^2 := by rw [Real.rpow_neg_one, inv_pow]

∀ s : ℝ, ∀ f : KdVPlan.Coeff, ∀ a : ℤ → ℝ, ∀ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C → Summable a →
 (∀ k, KdVPlan.weight s k * ‖f k‖^2 ≤ C^2*a k) → KdVPlan.HB s f (C*Real.sqrt (∑' k, a k))
helpers.proof:
intro s f a C hC ha h
have hf : KdVPlan.MemH s f := Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun k => mul_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg (by positivity) _) (sq_nonneg _)) h (ha.mul_left (C^2))
refine ⟨hf, ?_⟩
change Real.sqrt _ ≤ _
calc
 Real.sqrt (∑' k, KdVPlan.weight s k * ‖f k‖^2) ≤ Real.sqrt (∑' k, C^2*a k) :=
  Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (hf.tsum_le_tsum h (ha.mul_left (C^2)))
 _ = C*Real.sqrt (∑' k, a k) := by rw [tsum_mul_left, Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg C), Real.sqrt_sq hC]

helpers.statement:
(∀ t : ℝ, ∀ f g : KdVPlan.Coeff, KdVPlan.MemH 0 f → KdVPlan.MemH 0 g →
 KdVPlan.HB (-KdVPlan.pstar) (KdVPlan.B t f g) (Real.sqrt (∑' k : ℤ, KdVPlan.weight (-KdVPlan.pstar) k*(k : ℝ)^2)*KdVPlan.hn 0 f*KdVPlan.hn 0 g)) ∧
 (∀ f g : KdVPlan.Coeff, KdVPlan.MemH 0 f → KdVPlan.MemH 0 g →
 KdVPlan.HB 0 (KdVPlan.invD (KdVPlan.P (KdVPlan.mul f g))) (KdVPlan.hn 0 (fun k => (Complex.I * (k : ℂ))⁻¹)*KdVPlan.hn 0 f*KdVPlan.hn 0 g)) ∧
 (∀ A : KdVPlan.Coeff, KdVPlan.ZeroMean A → KdVPlan.MemH 0 (KdVPlan.invD A) → KdVPlan.HB (-KdVPlan.pstar) A (KdVPlan.hn 0 (KdVPlan.invD A)))
helpers.proof:
constructor
· intro t f g hf hg
  have Hf := (yui_aux_0018 T gamma R h_T013).1 0 t f hf
  have Hg := (yui_aux_0018 T gamma R h_T013).1 0 t g hg
  have Hc := (yui_aux_0005 T gamma R h_T013 _ _ Hf.1 Hg.1).2
  have H := yui_aux_0020 T gamma R h_T013 (-KdVPlan.pstar) (KdVPlan.B t f g)
   (fun k : ℤ => KdVPlan.weight (-KdVPlan.pstar) k*(k : ℝ)^2) (KdVPlan.hn 0 f*KdVPlan.hn 0 g)
   (mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)) (yui_aux_0019 T gamma R h_T013).1 (fun k => ?_)
  · convert H using 1 <;> ring
  · have hw : 0 ≤ KdVPlan.weight (-KdVPlan.pstar) k := Real.rpow_nonneg (by positivity) _
    have hc : ‖KdVPlan.mul (KdVPlan.S t f) (KdVPlan.S t g) k‖ ≤ KdVPlan.hn 0 f*KdVPlan.hn 0 g := by simpa only [Hf.2.1, Hg.2.1] using (Hc k).2
    simp only [KdVPlan.B, yui_aux_0017 T gamma R h_T013, (yui_aux_0008 T gamma R h_T013).1 _ k |>.2.2, mul_pow, sq_abs]
    calc
     KdVPlan.weight (-KdVPlan.pstar) k * ((k : ℝ)^2 * ‖KdVPlan.mul (KdVPlan.S t f) (KdVPlan.S t g) k‖^2) ≤ KdVPlan.weight (-KdVPlan.pstar) k * ((k : ℝ)^2 * (KdVPlan.hn 0 f*KdVPlan.hn 0 g)^2) := by
      gcongr
     _ = (KdVPlan.hn 0 f)^2*(KdVPlan.hn 0 g)^2*(KdVPlan.weight (-KdVPlan.pstar) k*(k : ℝ)^2) := by ring
constructor
· intro f g hf hg
  rw [(yui_aux_0013 T gamma R h_T013 _).2]
  have H := yui_aux_0002 T gamma R h_T013 0 0 (KdVPlan.invD (KdVPlan.mul f g))
   (fun k => (Complex.I*(k : ℂ))⁻¹) (KdVPlan.hn 0 f*KdVPlan.hn 0 g)
   (mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)) (yui_aux_0008 T gamma R h_T013).2 (fun k => ?_)
  · convert H using 1 <;> ring
  · rw [(yui_aux_0008 T gamma R h_T013).1 (KdVPlan.mul f g) k |>.1]
    simp only [KdVPlan.weight, Real.rpow_zero, one_mul, norm_mul, mul_pow]
    have Hc := (yui_aux_0005 T gamma R h_T013 f g hf hg).2 k |>.2
    calc
     ‖(Complex.I*(k : ℂ))⁻¹‖^2 * ‖KdVPlan.mul f g k‖^2 ≤ ‖(Complex.I*(k : ℂ))⁻¹‖^2 * (KdVPlan.hn 0 f*KdVPlan.hn 0 g)^2 :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ((sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _))).mpr Hc) (sq_nonneg _)
     _ = (KdVPlan.hn 0 f)^2 * (KdVPlan.hn 0 g)^2 * ‖(Complex.I*(k : ℂ))⁻¹‖^2 := by ring
· intro A hA hIA
  have H := yui_aux_0002 T gamma R h_T013 (-KdVPlan.pstar) 0 A (KdVPlan.invD A) 1 (by norm_num) hIA (fun k => ?_)
  · simpa only [one_mul] using H
  · by_cases hk : k = 0
    · have hA0 : A 0 = 0 := hA
      simp [hk, KdVPlan.invD, hA0]
    · rw [(yui_aux_0008 T gamma R h_T013).1 A k |>.2.1]
      simp only [KdVPlan.weight, Real.rpow_zero, one_mul, one_pow, mul_pow, ← abs_inv, sq_abs]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ((yui_aux_0019 T gamma R h_T013).2 k hk) (sq_nonneg _)

(∀ t : ℝ, ∀ f g : KdVPlan.Coeff, KdVPlan.MemH 0 f → KdVPlan.MemH 0 g →
 KdVPlan.HB 1 (KdVPlan.J t f g) (12 * (1 + KdVPlan.hn 0 (fun k => (Complex.I*(k : ℂ))⁻¹))*KdVPlan.hn 0 f*KdVPlan.hn 0 g)) ∧
 (∀ t : ℝ, ∀ A g : KdVPlan.Coeff, KdVPlan.MemH 0 (KdVPlan.invD A) → KdVPlan.MemH 0 g →
 KdVPlan.HB 0 (KdVPlan.J t A g) (KdVPlan.hn 0 (fun k => (Complex.I*(k : ℂ))⁻¹)*KdVPlan.hn 0 (KdVPlan.invD A)*KdVPlan.hn 0 g))
helpers.proof:
have sp : ∀ s t : ℝ, ∀ f : KdVPlan.Coeff, KdVPlan.MemH s f → KdVPlan.HB s (KdVPlan.S (-t) (KdVPlan.P f)) (KdVPlan.hn s f) := by
 intro s t f hf
 have Hp := (yui_aux_0018 T gamma R h_T013).1 s 0 f hf |>.2.2
 have HS := (yui_aux_0018 T gamma R h_T013).1 s (-t) (KdVPlan.P f) Hp.1
 exact ⟨HS.1, HS.2.1.trans_le Hp.2⟩
constructor
· intro t f g hf hg
  have Hif := (yui_aux_0009 T gamma R h_T013 f hf).1
  have Hig := (yui_aux_0009 T gamma R h_T013 g hg).1
  have Hsf := (yui_aux_0018 T gamma R h_T013).1 1 t (KdVPlan.invD f) Hif.1
  have Hsg := (yui_aux_0018 T gamma R h_T013).1 1 t (KdVPlan.invD g) Hig.1
  have Hm := yui_aux_0016 T gamma R h_T013 _ _ Hsf.1 Hsg.1
  have Hout := sp 1 t _ Hm.1
  refine ⟨Hout.1, Hout.2.trans (Hm.2.trans ?_)⟩
  rw [Hsf.2.1, Hsg.2.1]
  let E := 1 + KdVPlan.hn 0 (fun k => (Complex.I*(k : ℂ))⁻¹)
  have hE : 0 ≤ 3*E := by dsimp [E, KdVPlan.hn]; positivity
  calc
   3*E*KdVPlan.hn 1 (KdVPlan.invD f)*KdVPlan.hn 1 (KdVPlan.invD g) ≤ 3*E*(2*KdVPlan.hn 0 f)*(2*KdVPlan.hn 0 g) :=
    mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left Hif.2 hE) Hig.2 (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (by dsimp [KdVPlan.hn]; positivity)
   _ = 12*E*KdVPlan.hn 0 f*KdVPlan.hn 0 g := by ring
· intro t A g hIA hg
  have HIA := (yui_aux_0018 T gamma R h_T013).1 0 t (KdVPlan.invD A) hIA
  have HIg := yui_aux_0009 T gamma R h_T013 g hg
  have hls : Summable (fun k => ‖KdVPlan.S t (KdVPlan.invD g) k‖) := by simpa only [yui_aux_0017 T gamma R h_T013] using HIg.2.1
  have Hm := yui_aux_0007 T gamma R h_T013 (KdVPlan.S t (KdVPlan.invD g)) (KdVPlan.S t (KdVPlan.invD A)) hls HIA.1
  rw [(yui_aux_0015 T gamma R h_T013).1 (KdVPlan.S t (KdVPlan.invD g)) (KdVPlan.S t (KdVPlan.invD A))] at Hm
  have Hout := sp 0 t _ Hm.1
  refine ⟨Hout.1, Hout.2.trans (Hm.2.trans ?_)⟩
  simp only [yui_aux_0017 T gamma R h_T013, HIA.2.1]
  calc
   (∑' k, ‖KdVPlan.invD g k‖)*KdVPlan.hn 0 (KdVPlan.invD A) ≤ (KdVPlan.hn 0 (fun k => (Complex.I*(k : ℂ))⁻¹)*KdVPlan.hn 0 g)*KdVPlan.hn 0 (KdVPlan.invD A) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right HIg.2.2 (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
   _ = _ := by ring

helpers.name: yui_aux_0023
helpers.statement:
∀ s r q : ℝ, ∀ A : KdVPlan.Coeff → KdVPlan.Coeff → KdVPlan.Coeff, ∀ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C →
 (∀ f g, KdVPlan.MemH s f → KdVPlan.MemH r g → KdVPlan.HB q (A f g) (C*KdVPlan.hn s f*KdVPlan.hn r g)) →
 (∀ f f' g g', KdVPlan.MemH s f → KdVPlan.MemH s f' → KdVPlan.MemH r g → KdVPlan.MemH r g' →
 A f g-A f' g' = A (f-f') g+A f' (g-g')) → KdVPlan.FourierApprox2 s r q A
helpers.proof:
intro s r q A C hC hB hdiff f g hf hg
refine ⟨(hB f g hf hg).1, ?_⟩
intro ε hε
let K := C*(KdVPlan.hn s f+KdVPlan.hn r g)
have hnf : 0 ≤ KdVPlan.hn s f := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
have hng : 0 ≤ KdVPlan.hn r g := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
have hK : 0 ≤ K := mul_nonneg hC (add_nonneg hnf hng)
let δ := ε/(K+1)
have hδ : 0 < δ := div_pos hε (by linarith)
obtain ⟨m₁, hm₁⟩ := (h_T013.2.2.1 s f hf).2 δ hδ
obtain ⟨m₂, hm₂⟩ := (h_T013.2.2.1 r g hg).2 δ hδ
refine ⟨max m₁ m₂, ?_⟩
intro n hindex
have hfcut := (yui_aux_0018 T gamma R h_T013).2.1 s (n : ℝ) f hf
have hgcut := (yui_aux_0018 T gamma R h_T013).2.1 r (n : ℝ) g hg
have hfd := hm₁ n ((le_max_left _ _).trans hindex)
have hgd := hm₂ n ((le_max_right _ _).trans hindex)
have H₁ := hB (KdVPlan.cutoff (n : ℝ) f-f) (KdVPlan.cutoff (n : ℝ) g) hfd.1 hgcut.1
have H₂ := hB f (KdVPlan.cutoff (n : ℝ) g-g) hf hgd.1
rw [hdiff _ _ _ _ hfcut.1 hf hgcut.1 hg]
have Hsum := yui_aux_0001 T gamma R h_T013 q _ _ H₁.1 H₂.1
refine ⟨Hsum.1, Hsum.2.1.trans ((add_le_add H₁.2 H₂.2).trans ?_)⟩
have b₁ : C*KdVPlan.hn s (KdVPlan.cutoff (n : ℝ) f-f)*KdVPlan.hn r (KdVPlan.cutoff (n : ℝ) g) ≤ C*δ*KdVPlan.hn r g :=
 mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfd.2 hC) hgcut.2 (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg hC hδ.le)
have b₂ : C*KdVPlan.hn s f*KdVPlan.hn r (KdVPlan.cutoff (n : ℝ) g-g) ≤ C*KdVPlan.hn s f*δ :=
 mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hgd.2 (mul_nonneg hC hnf)
have hδeq : δ*(K+1) = ε := div_mul_cancel₀ ε (by linarith)
calc
 C*KdVPlan.hn s (KdVPlan.cutoff (n : ℝ) f-f)*KdVPlan.hn r (KdVPlan.cutoff (n : ℝ) g) + C*KdVPlan.hn s f*KdVPlan.hn r (KdVPlan.cutoff (n : ℝ) g-g) ≤ C*δ*KdVPlan.hn r g+C*KdVPlan.hn s f*δ := add_le_add b₁ b₂
 _ = δ*K := by dsimp [K]; ring
 _ ≤ ε := by nlinarith

              KdVPlan.MemH s f →
                KdVPlan.MemH s f' →
                  KdVPlan.MemH r g → KdVPlan.MemH r g' → A f g - A f' g' = A (f - f') g + A f' (g - g')) →

helpers.name: yui_aux_0024
helpers.statement:
∀ f f' g g' : KdVPlan.Coeff, KdVPlan.MemH 0 f → KdVPlan.MemH 0 f' → KdVPlan.MemH 0 g → KdVPlan.MemH 0 g' →
 KdVPlan.mul f g-KdVPlan.mul f' g' = KdVPlan.mul (f-f') g+KdVPlan.mul f' (g-g')
helpers.proof:
intro f f' g g' hf hf' hg hg'
have hfd := yui_aux_0001 T gamma R h_T013 0 f f' hf hf' |>.2.2.1
have hgd := yui_aux_0001 T gamma R h_T013 0 g g' hg hg' |>.2.2.1
funext k
have h₁ := (yui_aux_0005 T gamma R h_T013 f g hf hg).2 k |>.1
have h₂ := (yui_aux_0005 T gamma R h_T013 f' g' hf' hg').2 k |>.1
have h₃ := (yui_aux_0005 T gamma R h_T013 (f-f') g hfd hg).2 k |>.1
have h₄ := (yui_aux_0005 T gamma R h_T013 f' (g-g') hf' hgd).2 k |>.1
change (∑' j, f j*g (k-j))-(∑' j, f' j*g' (k-j)) =
 (∑' j, (f-f') j*g (k-j))+(∑' j, f' j*(g-g') (k-j))
rw [← h₁.tsum_sub h₂, ← h₃.tsum_add h₄]
apply tsum_congr
intro j
simp only [Pi.sub_apply]
ring

helpers.statement:
∀ t : ℝ, ∀ f f' g g' : KdVPlan.Coeff, KdVPlan.MemH 0 f → KdVPlan.MemH 0 f' → KdVPlan.MemH 0 g → KdVPlan.MemH 0 g' →
 (KdVPlan.B t f g-KdVPlan.B t f' g' = KdVPlan.B t (f-f') g+KdVPlan.B t f' (g-g')) ∧
 (KdVPlan.J t f g-KdVPlan.J t f' g' = KdVPlan.J t (f-f') g+KdVPlan.J t f' (g-g')) ∧
 (KdVPlan.invD (KdVPlan.P (KdVPlan.mul f g))-KdVPlan.invD (KdVPlan.P (KdVPlan.mul f' g')) =
  KdVPlan.invD (KdVPlan.P (KdVPlan.mul (f-f') g))+KdVPlan.invD (KdVPlan.P (KdVPlan.mul f' (g-g'))))
helpers.proof:
intro t f f' g g' hf hf' hg hg'
have hS : ∀ t : ℝ, ∀ f g : KdVPlan.Coeff, KdVPlan.S t (f-g) = KdVPlan.S t f-KdVPlan.S t g := fun t f g => (yui_aux_0018 T gamma R h_T013).2.2 f g t |>.1
have hI : ∀ f g : KdVPlan.Coeff, KdVPlan.invD (f-g) = KdVPlan.invD f-KdVPlan.invD g := fun f g => (yui_aux_0018 T gamma R h_T013).2.2 f g 0 |>.2.1
have hP : ∀ f g : KdVPlan.Coeff, KdVPlan.P (f-g) = KdVPlan.P f-KdVPlan.P g := fun f g => (yui_aux_0018 T gamma R h_T013).2.2 f g 0 |>.2.2.1
have hD : ∀ f g : KdVPlan.Coeff, KdVPlan.dx (f-g) = KdVPlan.dx f-KdVPlan.dx g := fun f g => (yui_aux_0018 T gamma R h_T013).2.2 f g 0 |>.2.2.2
have hi : ∀ f : KdVPlan.Coeff, KdVPlan.MemH 0 f → KdVPlan.MemH 0 (KdVPlan.invD f) := by
 intro f hf
 exact ((yui_aux_0011 T gamma R h_T013).1 _ (yui_aux_0009 T gamma R h_T013 f hf).1.1).1.1
have hs : ∀ f : KdVPlan.Coeff, KdVPlan.MemH 0 f → KdVPlan.MemH 0 (KdVPlan.S t f) := fun f hf => (yui_aux_0018 T gamma R h_T013).1 0 t f hf |>.1
refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
· calc
   KdVPlan.B t f g-KdVPlan.B t f' g' = KdVPlan.S (-t) (KdVPlan.dx (KdVPlan.mul (KdVPlan.S t f) (KdVPlan.S t g)-KdVPlan.mul (KdVPlan.S t f') (KdVPlan.S t g'))) := by rw [hD, hS]; rfl
   _ = KdVPlan.S (-t) (KdVPlan.dx (KdVPlan.mul (KdVPlan.S t (f-f')) (KdVPlan.S t g)+KdVPlan.mul (KdVPlan.S t f') (KdVPlan.S t (g-g')))) := by
    rw [yui_aux_0024 T gamma R h_T013 _ _ _ _ (hs f hf) (hs f' hf') (hs g hg) (hs g' hg'), hS, hS]
   _ = KdVPlan.B t (f-f') g+KdVPlan.B t f' (g-g') := by funext k; simp only [KdVPlan.B, KdVPlan.S, KdVPlan.dx, Pi.add_apply, mul_add]
· calc
   KdVPlan.J t f g-KdVPlan.J t f' g' = KdVPlan.S (-t) (KdVPlan.P (KdVPlan.mul (KdVPlan.S t (KdVPlan.invD f)) (KdVPlan.S t (KdVPlan.invD g))-KdVPlan.mul (KdVPlan.S t (KdVPlan.invD f')) (KdVPlan.S t (KdVPlan.invD g')))) := by rw [hP, hS]; rfl
   _ = KdVPlan.S (-t) (KdVPlan.P (KdVPlan.mul (KdVPlan.S t (KdVPlan.invD (f-f'))) (KdVPlan.S t (KdVPlan.invD g))+KdVPlan.mul (KdVPlan.S t (KdVPlan.invD f')) (KdVPlan.S t (KdVPlan.invD (g-g'))))) := by
    rw [yui_aux_0024 T gamma R h_T013 _ _ _ _ (hs _ (hi f hf)) (hs _ (hi f' hf')) (hs _ (hi g hg)) (hs _ (hi g' hg')), hI, hI, hS, hS]
   _ = KdVPlan.J t (f-f') g+KdVPlan.J t f' (g-g') := by
    funext k
    by_cases hk : k = 0 <;> simp only [KdVPlan.J, KdVPlan.S, KdVPlan.P, Pi.add_apply, hk, ↓reduceIte, mul_add, mul_zero, zero_add]
· calc
   KdVPlan.invD (KdVPlan.P (KdVPlan.mul f g))-KdVPlan.invD (KdVPlan.P (KdVPlan.mul f' g')) = KdVPlan.invD (KdVPlan.P (KdVPlan.mul f g-KdVPlan.mul f' g')) := by rw [hP, hI]
   _ = KdVPlan.invD (KdVPlan.P (KdVPlan.mul (f-f') g+KdVPlan.mul f' (g-g'))) := by rw [yui_aux_0024 T gamma R h_T013 f f' g g' hf hf' hg hg']
   _ = KdVPlan.invD (KdVPlan.P (KdVPlan.mul (f-f') g))+KdVPlan.invD (KdVPlan.P (KdVPlan.mul f' (g-g'))) := by
    funext k
    by_cases hk : k = 0 <;> simp [KdVPlan.invD, KdVPlan.P, hk, mul_add]

let D := KdVPlan.hn 0 (fun k => (Complex.I*(k : ℂ))⁻¹)
have hD : 0 ≤ D := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
have h10 : ∀ f : KdVPlan.Coeff, KdVPlan.MemH 1 f → KdVPlan.MemH 0 f := fun f hf => ((yui_aux_0011 T gamma R h_T013).1 f hf).1.1
refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
· intro f hf
  refine ⟨(yui_aux_0009 T gamma R h_T013 f hf).1.1, ?_⟩
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := (h_T013.2.2.1 0 f hf).2 (ε/2) (by linarith)
  refine ⟨m, ?_⟩
  intro n hindex
  have Hn := hm n hindex
  have HI := (yui_aux_0009 T gamma R h_T013 (KdVPlan.cutoff (n : ℝ) f-f) Hn.1).1
  rw [(yui_aux_0018 T gamma R h_T013).2.2 (KdVPlan.cutoff (n : ℝ) f) f 0 |>.2.1] at HI
  exact ⟨HI.1, HI.2.trans (by linarith [Hn.2])⟩
· apply yui_aux_0023 T gamma R h_T013 1 1 1 KdVPlan.mul (3*(1+D)) (by linarith)
  · exact yui_aux_0016 T gamma R h_T013
  · intro f f' g g' hf hf' hg hg'
    exact yui_aux_0024 T gamma R h_T013 f f' g g' (h10 f hf) (h10 f' hf') (h10 g hg) (h10 g' hg')
· intro t
  constructor
  · apply yui_aux_0023 T gamma R h_T013 0 0 (-KdVPlan.pstar) (KdVPlan.B t) (Real.sqrt (∑' k : ℤ, KdVPlan.weight (-KdVPlan.pstar) k*(k : ℝ)^2)) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
    · exact (yui_aux_0021 T gamma R h_T013).1 t
    · intro f f' g g' hf hf' hg hg'
      exact (yui_aux_0025 T gamma R h_T013 t f f' g g' hf hf' hg hg').1
  · apply yui_aux_0023 T gamma R h_T013 0 0 1 (KdVPlan.J t) (12*(1+D)) (by linarith)
    · exact (yui_aux_0022 T gamma R h_T013).1 t
    · intro f f' g g' hf hf' hg hg'
      exact (yui_aux_0025 T gamma R h_T013 t f f' g g' hf hf' hg hg').2.1
· apply yui_aux_0023 T gamma R h_T013 0 0 0 (fun f g => KdVPlan.invD (KdVPlan.P (KdVPlan.mul f g))) D hD
  · exact (yui_aux_0021 T gamma R h_T013).2.1
  · intro f f' g g' hf hf' hg hg'
    exact (yui_aux_0025 T gamma R h_T013 0 f f' g g' hf hf' hg hg').2.2

let D := KdVPlan.hn 0 (fun k => (Complex.I*(k : ℂ))⁻¹)
let V := Real.sqrt (∑' k : ℤ, KdVPlan.weight (-KdVPlan.pstar) k*(k : ℝ)^2)
let C := 2+V+12*(1+D)
have hD : 0 ≤ D := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
have hV : 0 ≤ V := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
have hC : 0 < C := by dsimp [C]; linarith
have hC2 : 2 ≤ C := by dsimp [C]; linarith
have hCD : D ≤ C := by dsimp [C]; linarith
have hCV : V ≤ C := by dsimp [C]; linarith
have hCE : 3*(1+D) ≤ C := by dsimp [C]; linarith
have hCJ : 12*(1+D) ≤ C := by dsimp [C]; linarith
have mono₁ : ∀ a b x : ℝ, a ≤ b → 0 ≤ x → a*x ≤ b*x := fun a b x hab hx => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hab hx
have mono₂ : ∀ a b x y : ℝ, a ≤ b → 0 ≤ x → 0 ≤ y → a*x*y ≤ b*x*y := fun a b x y hab hx hy => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mono₁ a b x hab hx) hy
refine ⟨⟨C, hC, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩, yui_aux_0026 T gamma R h_T013⟩
· intro f hf hz
  have H := yui_aux_0009 T gamma R h_T013 f hf
  have Hl := yui_aux_0010 T gamma R h_T013 (KdVPlan.invD f) H.2.1
  refine ⟨⟨H.1.1, H.1.2.trans (mono₁ 2 C (KdVPlan.hn 0 f) hC2 (Real.sqrt_nonneg _))⟩, Hl.1, ?_⟩
  exact Hl.2.trans (H.2.2.trans (mono₁ D C (KdVPlan.hn 0 f) hCD (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)))
· intro f g hf hg
  have H := yui_aux_0016 T gamma R h_T013 f g hf hg
  exact ⟨H.1, H.2.trans (mono₂ (3*(1+D)) C (KdVPlan.hn 1 f) (KdVPlan.hn 1 g) hCE (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _))⟩
· intro t f g hf hg
  have Hb := (yui_aux_0021 T gamma R h_T013).1 t f g hf hg
  have Hj := (yui_aux_0022 T gamma R h_T013).1 t f g hf hg
  have Hi := (yui_aux_0021 T gamma R h_T013).2.1 f g hf hg
  refine ⟨⟨Hb.1, Hb.2.trans (mono₂ V C (KdVPlan.hn 0 f) (KdVPlan.hn 0 g) hCV (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _))⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact ⟨Hj.1, Hj.2.trans (mono₂ (12*(1+D)) C (KdVPlan.hn 0 f) (KdVPlan.hn 0 g) hCJ (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _))⟩
  · exact ⟨Hi.1, Hi.2.trans (mono₂ D C (KdVPlan.hn 0 f) (KdVPlan.hn 0 g) hCD (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _))⟩
· intro t A g hz hIA hg
  have Hj := (yui_aux_0022 T gamma R h_T013).2 t A g hIA hg
  exact ⟨(yui_aux_0021 T gamma R h_T013).2.2 A hz hIA, Hj.1,
    Hj.2.trans (mono₂ D C (KdVPlan.hn 0 (KdVPlan.invD A)) (KdVPlan.hn 0 g) hCD (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _))⟩
